metadata.title: Machu Bandal Kappa | Beef Tripe Kappa |  Garo Recipe
metadata.description:
Tripe is one of the choicest organ meat when it comes to making kappa. The soft texture of the meat tenderized by lye (liquid alkali) with lot of heat from fresh green chilies and ginger adds an amazing depth to the dish. Here is a list of ingredients that you will require to make this dish;

Ingredients

Beef Tripe - 250 gms
Chilies  - 15-20 nos (more if you like it super hot)
Ginger  - 3-4 inch piece
Liquid Alkali (Kalchi/Khar) or Cooking Soda - 1tsp

Lets Connect!
